d:
In this video, I went to Thailand and bought the brand new iPhone 18 Pro, and the best part was the price!
The iPhone 18 Pro cost me around ₹40,000 to ₹45,000 cheaper than buying the same phone in India. So was it actually a good deal?
I’ll take you through the entire process of buying an iPhone in Thailand, including where I bought it, how much I paid, how the Thailand tax refund works, and everything you need to know before buying an iPhone abroad.
